canonical_pattern: Developing probabilistic programming language with exact inference for loops — Performance was too abysmal to be practical, preventing publicizing of working prototype for years

Email service providers automatically send notifications and receipts to customers using standardized 'no-reply@' sender addresses — Organizations unknowingly expose customer PII, account details, and transaction data to unintended third-party recipients through typos in no-reply addresses

Operating public bug tracking infrastructure under load from automated scrapers — AI bot scrapers consuming enough resources to force complete service shutdown, blocking legitimate developer access to critical bug tracking
